description: This file defines the core DOM node class for CKEditor, handling DOM node instantiation, node type constants, and various node manipulation methods.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.node
classes.description: The core class representing DOM nodes, providing construction and manipulation methods such as append, clone, remove, insert, and navigation within the DOM tree.

methods.name: appendTo
methods.description: Makes this node a child of another element, appending it.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep or shallow copy of the node, optionally removing IDs and expando data.

methods.name: hasPrevious
methods.description: Checks if this node has a previous sibling.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if this node has a next sibling.

methods.name: insertAfter
methods.description: Inserts this node after a specified node.

methods.name: insertBefore
methods.description: Inserts this node before a specified node.

methods.name: insertBeforeMe
methods.description: Inserts the given node before this node.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns a tree address array representing the node's position.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Returns the document object containing this node.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns this node's index among its siblings.

methods.name: getNextSourceNode
methods.description: Traverses the DOM forward to find the next source node of specified type and guard.

methods.name: getPreviousSourceNode
methods.description: Traverses the DOM backward to find the previous source node of specified type and guard.

methods.name: getPrevious
methods.description: Returns the previous sibling node, optionally filtered by an evaluator.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next sibling node, optionally filtered by an evaluator.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent element of this node.

methods.name: getParents
methods.description: Returns an array of ancestors, either closest first or furthest first.

methods.name: getCommonAncestor
methods.description: Finds the closest shared ancestor with another node.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Determines the positional relationship between this node and another node.

methods.name: getAscendant
methods.description: Finds the closest ancestor node with a specific tag name.

methods.name: hasAscendant
methods.description: Checks if such an ancestor exists.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves this node to a new target position within the DOM.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes this node from the DOM, with an option to preserve children.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces this node with another node.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from both ends of the node's text content.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the start of the node's text content.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the end of the node's text content.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if this node is read-only, considering ancestor elements.
